/ to show the improvement on previous vs. now, as they have improved massively: **

--- Old Review from 2024-ish from memory --
Extremely poor service. Put in prescription request over 72hrs, regularly they miss it then claim they have no idea about it. Ask for help with something and it's "so and so receptionist can deal with that, come back when they're here" when the person you just spoke to is on reception too. It has always been hit or miss whether my prescription gets picked up each month sometimes it does other times like now, they don't check emails or respond very rarely.

I don't have an issue with the doctors.. Nancy Maningo especially is lovely. It's mostly the receptionist and really poor service when booking or trying to get your repeat prescriptions sorted. Nurses have always been good with blood tests, and very friendly - the GPs I see are all good. It is just awful reception and customer service side which is very frustrating to deal with.

Also can echo the fact many times you ring even at 8am, you will not be answered until 9:50 sometimes, and then no appointments left. This has happened to my mother many times. NHS cuts are a problem but for me the biggest issue is how many times I put in my prescription every month for it to be missed and then I have to chase to a receptionist who says they know nothing about it.

I am now out of my medication I take daily and again today, dealing with clueless receptionists who claim they haven't received anything... it was in writing to you via email the same way it is done every month..!

-- Update from 2025 - Improvements made hugely --

I am updating my score as the service has improved considerably with no issues to my prescriptions anymore, plus they were majorly helpful in helping me with urgent care for an infection. I had seen the urgent care doctor at another clinic for a serious ear infection but no pharmacy had the antibiotics. When I rang Willows as my local GP they got me in to see a doctor immediately and change the antibiotic item to one in stock which has Seriously helped me as the pain was spreading to my jaw and face earlier and I feared it could get worse without any antibiotics. I was so relieved as I feared not addressing it today would have caused it to get worse.

But overall my comments from 4 months to now are vastly different as the surgery seems to have improved a lot and I'm no longer having the same issues as I was having. I think theres still a bit of issues with getting appointments in the morning which seems to be a universal NHS doctor strain so not specific to the practice but overall I was really grateful they heard out what I had said and are improving a lot. Thank you

-- More update as of March 2026 --

The service still is improving, and I think even getting in now is easier. I've had more opportunities to book in fairly quick as I have regular bloodwork done and check ups and it's been a lot easier to get everything in place. They also send me text reminders to book in which makes it simple as sometimes I have a lot of different check ups so I can keep track of it better. A few times I've rang in and been offered an appointment on the same day or few days later. I haven't a clue what they did but they definetly got the surgery to improve massively over the last year. Theres a lot more opportunity to feed back as well now with links to say how your experience was which we didn't used to have so this is allowing the management to look into people's issues more effectively. Overall I would stay with my current GP surgery as I have no issues anymore and everything has been going really smoothly for
